units.source_text: 有一天，沉静的黎明时分，伺候人都不在身旁，值宿人员也都退去了，

en.t: One day, in the quiet hours before dawn, the attendants were not at his side, and those on night duty had also withdrawn,

units.source_text: 这僧都一面用老人特有的稳静声音咳嗽，一面为冷泉帝讲述人世无常之理。

en.t: the bishop, coughing in the calm, steady voice peculiar to old age, spoke to Emperor Reizei about the impermanence of the world.

units.source_text: 乘机言道：“贫僧有言，欲启奏陛下。

en.t: Seizing the opportunity, he said, "This humble monk has something he wishes to report to Your Majesty.

units.source_text: 因恐反获谎报之罪，故踌躇不决者久矣。

en.t: Because I feared I might instead be charged with making a false report, I have hesitated for a long time.

units.source_text: 但陛下若不知此事，罪孽甚大，贫僧恐受天罚。

en.t: But if Your Majesty remains unaware of this matter, the sin will be very grave, and I fear heavenly punishment.

units.source_text: 贫僧若将此事隐藏胸中，直至命终，则又有何益？

en.t: If I keep this matter hidden in my heart until the end of my life, what good could that possibly do?

units.source_text: 佛菩萨亦将呵斥贫僧之不忠。”

en.t: The Buddhas and bodhisattvas would also rebuke me for my disloyalty."

units.source_text: 他讲到这里，说不出口了。

en.t: Having spoken this far, he could say no more.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝想：“到底是什么事情？

en.t: Emperor Reizei thought, "What on earth can this be about?

units.source_text: 莫非他死后在这世间犹有余恨么？

en.t: Could it be that even after death he would still leave some lingering resentment in this world?

units.source_text: 做和尚的，无论何等清高，往往贪馋嫉妒，实在讨厌。”

en.t: Monks, no matter how pure and lofty they seem, are often greedy and jealous; they are truly tiresome."

units.source_text: 便对他说：“我从幼年时候就亲信你，你却有事隐忍不说，教我好恨啊！”

en.t: Then he said to him, "I have trusted you closely since I was a child, yet you have kept something hidden and refused to speak of it. How resentful that makes me!"

units.source_text: 僧都续说道：“阿弥陀佛！

en.t: The bishop continued, "Amitabha Buddha!

units.source_text: 佛菩萨所严禁泄露的真言秘诀，贫僧均已绝不保留地传授陛下。

en.t: Even the secret mantras that the Buddhas and bodhisattvas strictly forbid us to reveal, I have taught Your Majesty without holding anything back.

units.source_text: 贫僧自身，尚有何事隐忍在心？

en.t: What else could I myself still be hiding in my heart?

units.source_text: 惟有这一件，乃牵连过去未来之大事，如果隐瞒，只恐反而以恶名传闻于世，

en.t: Only this one matter is a grave affair touching both past and future; if it is concealed, I fear it may instead be passed down in the world as an evil rumor,

units.source_text: 于已故桐壶院和藤壶母后，以及当今执政之源氏内大臣，皆多不利。

en.t: bringing great harm to the late Kiritsubo Emperor, to Mother Empress Fujitsubo, and to the Genji Minister of the Interior who now governs.

units.source_text: 贫僧此老朽之身，毫不足惜，即使获罪，决不后悔。

en.t: This old and decayed body of mine is not worth the slightest regret; even if I am punished, I will never repent of speaking.

units.source_text: 今当仰承神佛之意，向陛下奏闻：陛下尚在胎内之时，母后便已悲伤忧恼，

en.t: Now, humbly receiving the will of the gods and Buddhas, I report to Your Majesty: when Your Majesty was still in the womb, the Mother Empress was already sorrowful and troubled,

units.source_text: 曾密嘱贫僧多方祈祷。

en.t: and she secretly instructed me to offer prayers in many ways.

units.source_text: 其中详情，出家之人当然不得而知。

en.t: As for the details, a person who had left the world could of course not know them.

units.source_text: 后来内大臣身蒙无实之罪，谪戍海隅，母后更加恐惧，

en.t: Later, when the Minister of the Interior was burdened with a baseless charge and exiled to the seacoast, the Mother Empress grew still more afraid,

units.source_text: 又嘱贫僧举行祈祷。

en.t: and again instructed me to perform prayers.

units.source_text: 内大臣闻知此事，亦曾命贫僧向佛忏悔。

en.t: When the Minister of the Interior learned of this matter, he too ordered me to make confession before the Buddha.

units.source_text: 陛下即位以前，贫僧不绝地为陛下祈求安泰也。

en.t: Before Your Majesty ascended the throne, I prayed without ceasing for Your Majesty's peace and safety.

units.source_text: 据贫僧所知……”便将事实详细奏闻。

en.t: As far as I know..." He then reported the facts in detail.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝听了他的话，如闻青天霹雳，恐惧悲伤，方寸缭乱，一时不能作答。

en.t: When Emperor Reizei heard his words, it was like a thunderclap from a clear sky; frightened, grieving, and utterly confused, he could not answer for a time.

units.source_text: 僧都自念唐突启奏，恼乱圣心，深恐获罪，便想悄悄退出。

en.t: The bishop thought that he had made a sudden report and disturbed the imperial heart, and, deeply afraid of punishment, he tried to withdraw quietly.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝留住了他，言道：“我倘不知此事而度送一生，深恐来世亦当受罪。

en.t: Emperor Reizei stopped him and said, "If I had lived out my whole life without knowing this matter, I would deeply fear being punished even in the next world.

units.source_text: 惟你隐忍至今方始告我，反教我怨你不忠了。

en.t: But because you kept silent until now before telling me, you have made me resent your disloyalty instead.

units.source_text: 我且问你：除你以外，有否别人知道此事而泄露于外？”

en.t: Let me ask you this: aside from you, is there anyone else who knows this matter and has leaked it outside?"

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“除贫僧及王命妇之外，并无他人知此情由。

en.t: The bishop answered, "Apart from this humble monk and Lady Omyobu, no one else knows these circumstances.

units.source_text: 贫僧今日奏闻，心中实甚恐惧。

en.t: In making this report today, I am truly filled with fear.

units.source_text: 近来天变频仍，疫疠流行，其原因即在于此。

en.t: The repeated portents in the heavens and the spread of pestilence in recent times have their cause precisely in this.

units.source_text: 陛下年幼之时，尚未通达世事，故神佛亦不计较。

en.t: When Your Majesty was young and did not yet understand worldly affairs, the gods and Buddhas did not hold it against you.

units.source_text: 今陛下年事渐长，万事已能明辨是非，神佛即降灾殃，以示惩罚不孝之罪也。

en.t: Now that Your Majesty has grown older and can clearly distinguish right from wrong in all things, the gods and Buddhas have sent down calamities to show punishment for the sin of unfilial conduct.

units.source_text: 世间万事吉凶，其起因皆与父母有关。

en.t: In all worldly matters, whether fortune or misfortune, the cause is always connected with one's parents.

units.source_text: 陛下若不自知其罪，贫僧不胜忧惧。

en.t: If Your Majesty does not know your own fault, I cannot help but be filled with worry and fear.

units.source_text: 因此敢将深藏心底之事宣之于口。”

en.t: For that reason I dared to speak aloud what I had kept hidden deep in my heart."

units.source_text: 说时嘘唏不已。

en.t: As he spoke, he kept sobbing without cease.

units.source_text: 此时天色已明，僧都即便告退。

en.t: By then the sky had already grown light, and the bishop immediately took his leave.
